body:
After completing *Gossip or Printed Notice?*, visitors can open **Make your case**, compare two cited newspaper readings, choose support, write a claim and uncertainty, review an ungraded guide, and explicitly save the result to the existing field notebook.

The comparison supports all five audience tellings and stays collapsed beside the existing reflection. It preserves the missing land-sale figure and the Inferred Springfield building reading, with their locators and reasoning. Both newspaper citations remain text-only. No invented witnesses, source links, scans, route, service or notebook schema are added.

Saves preserve complete source context and earlier entries. Unchanged repeat clicks do not duplicate a note; revisions save a new copy. Deleted or independently edited notebook entries are detected, and full, damaged or unavailable storage leaves the draft intact.

**Dependency and draft status:** depends on #2197. Pushed head is `fc51c9efcd56f863a3493d67101ae2e1ec60e75e`, based on the `3472ec872` classroom candidate. The current DEV diff includes that parent delivery. After #2197 lands, rebase only the T-3663 work onto its actual DEV result and preserve the upstream changelog fold. Do not merge this draft before that integration and its own passing gates.

Validation completed:
- Actual compiled data across all five tellings: eligibility, committed visits, resolved citations, missing figure and shared American-item inference.
- Actual bounded notebook store and HTML export: explicit saves, repeat/revised/deleted/edited entries, storage failures, earlier-entry preservation and escaped student text.
- Existing reflection and notebook regressions; strings, changelog, syntax and diff checks.
- Registered pure gate step and official selected-tool isolation: no tracked or ignored writes; audit passes.

**Pending:** full source/preflight on the integrated branch; native keyboard, magnification and HTML/PDF fixture at both widths; fresh published stage 15 and actual completed Gossip flows at 390×780 and 1280×800, including shared daybook/Go-to paths. Other renderer evidence may be reused only after exact input and behavior review. No browser, publisher or full source gate was run for this feature while the current delivery owned the local renderer.

Recovery and evidence:
- [Committed validation checkpoint](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/blob/fc51c9efcd56f863a3493d67101ae2e1ec60e75e/chicago/4d/docs/RESEARCH/gossip-investigation-3663.md)
- [T-3663 ticket](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-tickets/blob/main/T-3500-3749/T-3663-make-your-case-compare-gossip-newspaper-readings.md)
- Local receipts: `/tmp/t3663-source-receipts/receipt.json`, `/tmp/t3663-isolation.log`, `/tmp/t3663-isolation-audit.log`; scope/equality review: `/tmp/t3663-scope-against-af.md` and `.json`; prepared, unrun fixture: `/tmp/t3663-investigation-browser.mjs`. These await the shared evidence archive. The pushed source and committed validation note are the durable checkpoint.

Targets DEV only; no production promotion.
